tools.name: search_sarees
tools.description: Search visible Vaanzari sarees using verified catalogue fields. Each result includes its canonical storefront url; include that url as a clickable product link when presenting products. Missing attributes remain unset.

tools.name: get_saree
tools.description: Get one visible Vaanzari saree by public catalogue ID or canonical locator. Includes its canonical storefront url; include that url as a clickable product link when presenting the product.

tools.name: list_artisans
tools.description: List public artisan profiles connected to the visible Vaanzari catalogue.

tools.name: get_artisan
tools.description: Get one public Vaanzari artisan profile.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the authorized customer account profile.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Update customer name, phone, and delivery address after signed-in browser approval.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read customer cart and current totals.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a visible saree to customer cart.

tools.name: set_cart_quantity
tools.description: Set quantity for one customer cart item.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove one customer cart item.

tools.name: get_picks
tools.description: Read saved Vaanzari picks.

tools.name: save_pick
tools.description: Save one visible saree to customer picks.

tools.name: remove_pick
tools.description: Remove one saree from customer picks.

tools.name: get_rewards
tools.description: Read customer reward balance and recent point transactions.

tools.name: get_checkout_summary
tools.description: Revalidate cart, discounts, points, addresses, and checkout total without placing an order.

tools.name: validate_coupon
tools.description: Validate a coupon against the authorized customer cart.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Create a hosted Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe, or Paytm checkout after signed-in browser approval, reserving stock/rewards and clearing the active cart. First call get_checkout_summary with the same addresses, discounts and points; submit its approved total/currency as expected_total/expected_currency

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List authorized customer orders.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get one authorized customer order.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an eligible customer order and send cancellation notices after signed-in browser approval.

tools.name: get_payment_status
tools.description: Refresh a customer payment attempt from Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe, or Paytm and persist its server-verified state. May finalize an already-paid order and send confirmation notices; does not initiate or capture payment.

tools.name: resume_payment
tools.description: Synchronize provider state and return an existing unpaid hosted checkout after signed-in browser approval. May finalize an already-paid order and send confirmation notices; does not capture payment.

tools.name: retry_payment
tools.description: Create a replacement hosted Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe, or Paytm checkout for a failed or terminated attempt after signed-in browser approval, reserving stock/rewards. Does not capture payment.

tools.name: cancel_payment_attempt
tools.description: Cancel an unpaid Cashfree session or check Razorpay/PhonePe/Paytm status after signed-in browser approval, then persist provider state. May restore reservations or finalize an already-paid order; does not capture payment.

tools.name: list_support_tickets
tools.description: List authorized customer support tickets.

tools.name: get_support_ticket
tools.description: Get one authorized customer support ticket and its messages.

tools.name: create_support_ticket
tools.description: Send a new customer support request to Vaanzari staff after signed-in browser approval. The submitted message cannot be unsent.

tools.name: reply_support_ticket
tools.description: Send a reply to Vaanzari support staff after signed-in browser approval, reopening a closed ticket if needed. The submitted message cannot be unsent.

tools.name: close_support_ticket
tools.description: Close a customer support ticket and send a closing remark to Vaanzari support staff after signed-in browser approval.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_sarees, get_saree, list_support_tickets, get_support_ticket · Public sink: start_checkout, cancel_order, get_payment_status, resume_payment, create_support_ticket, reply_support_ticket, close_support_ticket · Destructive: remove_from_cart, remove_pick.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_sarees, get_saree, list_support_tickets, get_support_ticket · Public sink: start_checkout, cancel_order, get_payment_status, resume_payment, create_support_ticket, reply_support_ticket, close_support_ticket · Destructive: remove_from_cart, remove_pick

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_checkout" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Create a hosted Cashfree, PhonePe, or Paytm checkout after signed-in browser approval, reserving stock/rewards and clearing the active cart. Paytm supports domestic INR only. Synchronizes any active payment first and may finalize an already-paid order. No payment is captured by this tool." → after: "Create a hosted Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe, or Paytm checkout after signed-in browser approval, reserving stock/rewards and clearing the active cart. First call get_checkout_summary with the same addresses, discounts and points; submit its approved total/currency as expected_total/expected_currency"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
